claim_scope: Raw-output source for the strongest formal entrant smoke test in the primary HCC analysis. Limited to Stage 2 HCC entrant smoke adjudication; not automatically a fuller model comparison.
input_space_description: HCC38 / HCC1143 single-feature-called cells with an in-dataset control baseline, normalized to target_sum=10000 and then log1p-transformed. GEARS trains and predicts on this normalized+log1p single-cell matrix.
output_space_description: Subtract shared control pseudobulk from GEARS predicted expression to obtain perturbation-level predicted_shift, followed by truth_aligned_log_shift export and validation.
